description: After a user changes their email in the profile, the verification mail sent to the new address links to the same page as the sign-up activation mail, and following it never completes the email change.
data_flow: AuthService.update signs a hash with confirmEmailUserId+newEmail and passes it to MailService.confirmNewEmail, which builds the frontend URL (frontendDomain + route) with ?hash=
The route path must be the new-email confirmation page so the frontend calls the confirm-new-email endpoint
notes: String constant copied from userSignUp. The template name and i18n keys are still the new-email ones, so the mail otherwise looks right.
